test_description: Corrupted active config — inject out-of-range Q7.8 weights (negative, 0, >0x3000) and unphysical probabilities (>=0.5, NaN) and verify active decoder bank is never overwritten
input_contract: Q7.8 weights must lie in [AVID_Q78_MIN_SAFE=0x0040, AVID_Q78_MAX_SAFE=0x3000]; invalid banks trigger hold/fallback without commit

expected.corrupted_bank_protection: bounds_ok=false rejected by quantizer; FSM reverts to SAFE_STATIC_PRIOR (0x0468=1128) and never selects corrupted candidate weights
